tools.name: check_email_deliverability
tools.description:
Check why emails from a domain might land in spam.

Looks up the domain's public DNS: SPF, DKIM (common selectors), DMARC, MX, and whether its
mail servers are on major blocklists. Returns a 0-100 score and plain-English issues, worst first.
Read-only: it changes nothing and sends no email. DKIM key

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email_deliverability · Public sink: check_email_deliverability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email_deliverability · Public sink: check_email_deliverability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
